original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚博尔诺州警方逮捕六名涉嫌手机盗窃及非法取款嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚博尔诺州警察指挥部逮捕六名嫌疑人，涉嫌盗窃一部手机并从机主银行账户非法取走565万奈拉。案件源于迈杜古里Damboa路一名居民的报案，受害人于2026年10月13日发现手机丢失。警方称此案涉及手机盗窃、犯罪共谋、欺诈及非法取款。目前信息仅来自单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 博尔诺州警方逮捕六名涉嫌手机盗窃及非法取款的嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Borno State Police Command has arrested six suspects over the theft of a mobile phone and the alleged unlawful withdrawal of N5.65m from the owner’s bank account.

key_facts.fact: 案件源于迈杜古里Damboa路一名居民的报案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The suspects were arrested following a complaint by a resident of Damboa Road, Maiduguri, identified as Abba K.

key_facts.fact: 受害人于2026年10月13日发现手机丢失
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: his Infinix Smart 8 phone went missing from his pocket after he alighted from a commercial tricycle on October 13, 2026.
unlawful withdrawal of ₦5.65 million from a bank account

uncertainties: 非法取款行为目前仅为指控，尚未经法院证实
案件信息仅来自单一来源（Punch），尚缺乏交叉验证
